about: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited is an environmental technology company providing engineering solutions in wastewater treatment, wastewater recycling and reuse, and solid waste treatment. Incorporated in 2005, it holds over 80% market share in India for sequencing batch reactor technology through its proprietary C-Tech platform. The company operates across India and select international markets.

objects.purpose: Prepayment of all or a portion of certain outstanding borrowings availed by Company and VWTPL

concentration.note: Top 10 customers accounted for 64.44% of revenue in FY26. Direct or indirect government-awarded projects represented 92.35% of FY26 revenue.

litigation_note: Contingent liability includes ₹0.02 crore for customs notices; subsidiaries SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH and others are involved in legal proceedings in Portugal and Austria.
strengths: Market leader in sequencing batch reactor technology in India with over 80% market share.
Proprietary technologies including C-Tech for wastewater treatment and OREX for municipal solid waste processing.
Strong cumulative treatment capacity of 17,464.61 MLD across 724 installations as of June 30, 2026.
Robust order book of ₹1,570.07 crore as of June 30, 2026 across WWT, WRR, and SWT segments.
High customer retention with repeat customers contributing 91.98% of FY26 revenue from operations.
Exclusive supply collaboration with DuPont for advanced tertiary wastewater treatment and recycling membranes.

risks.title: Government Entity Dependence
risks.detail: Revenues directly or indirectly attributable to government entities or tenders accounted for 92.35% of FY26 consolidated revenue.

risks.title: Negative Operating Cash Flows
risks.detail: Generated negative cash flows from operating activities of ₹25.80 crore in FY26 and ₹11.69 crore in FY24.

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers contributed 64.44% of revenue in FY26, with the largest customer representing 14.34%.

risks.title: Segment Concentration
risks.detail: Wastewater and solid waste treatment segments accounted for 84.98% of consolidated revenue from operations in FY26.

risks.title: Working Capital and Receivable Days
risks.detail: Trade receivable days expanded to 282 days in FY26, with cash conversion cycle stretching to 242 days.

risks.title: Technology Obsolescence Risk
risks.detail: Revenues depend heavily on proprietary C-Tech and OREX technologies, which may face displacement from newer technologies.

risks.title: Loans to Subsidiaries
risks.detail: Company has extended unsecured loans to subsidiaries that may be recalled and face repayment risks.

risks.title: Pending Legal Proceedings
risks.detail: Subsidiary SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH faces litigation in Portugal and Austria, alongside customs claims of ₹0.02 crore.

notes: Restated consolidated financial statements. FY24-FY26 audited periods extracted; June 30, 2025 and June 30, 2026 stub periods ignored in financial arrays.
